Team —

Board packet deadline is close (deck freeze on Friday). I need a quick, fact-checked sweep of Q2 forecasting and pipeline hygiene so we don’t ship numbers we can’t defend. Please do the following by Wednesday EOD PT (2026-06-03):

1) Update the attached commit_tracker_20260601.csv with every active deal. For each row set: Commit Status = {Commit | Up-for-Review | No-Commit}, Confirmed ACV, Expected Close Date, Primary Risk (discount/tech/PO).
2) In the ARR model (summary line in the CSV) put current ARR, committed net-new ARR this quarter, and a conservative midpoint.
3) Flag any deals > $250k that have material discounts or legal/infra dependencies — I’ll need one-line remediation plans.
4) If you disagree with any historical ARR math in the attached ARR_model_breakdown.xlsx, note the line and the suggested correction in the comments column.

I’ll consolidate inputs, roll up the numbers, and share a reconciled snapshot for review Thu morning. If you cannot meet the deadline, tell me which deals you need more time on and why — we can push into a follow-up slide but need to be explicit.

Attachment: commit_tracker_20260601.csv (template)

Thanks — quick and surgical here.
